title: Affine-query capacity with a uniform per-gate margin: 501935209511/100355805000

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. experiments.purpose: Regenerate centered sign moments, shifted graph cost and repair gain, starting majority, all finite relaxed Gaussian propagation layers and terminal majority; check both strict fairness endpoints and the claimed exact coefficient. Independently recompute the 41 joint exact entropy-dual inequalities and verify the per-gate margin and the exact intersection of the two branch increments.
